primary_antecedent.author: Lars Hörmander
primary_antecedent.title: The Analysis of Linear Partial Differential Operators III
primary_antecedent.receiving_contribution: Full matrix Robin boundary gauge, tangent-current energy estimate and actual H1 weak uniqueness, including identical natural-dual forcing.

source_correspondence: B0 retains the entire normalized scalar Lorentz wave principal class, arbitrary complex lower matrices, both physical form domains and the exact ordinary differential expression. The normal-coordinate pullback includes density and all differentiated multipliers.

B1 constructs an invertible boundary-identity matrix gauge with every tangential derivative controlled by the ordered series. It transforms both weak slots and the full natural antidual. The actual Robin trace becomes bare Neumann; the first normal derivative is retained.
B2 gives every ordinary-derivative lower coefficient and fixes L=P with principal G=-g. The signed Green formula establishes equivalence with the actual transformed weak problem.

B3 constructs a boundary-tangent timelike multiplier and proves positive time energy by completing the square. The exact vector current retains every complex matrix lower term and has zero physical flux in both homogeneous domains.

B4 proves weighted volume and terminal energy with constants independent of the weight parameter. It gives the full scalar-cutoff commutator and the precise normal-derivative condition needed for a Neumann cutoff.

B5 uses retarded tangential convolution on actual first derivatives. The graph equation gives H2 approximants; odd/even H2 reflection and past-supported smoothing preserve the exact domains. The full Friedrichs commutator converges strongly in L2. Summable subsequences and Fubini justify almost-everywhere terminal energy and the essential energy bound.

B6 proves positive outgoing artificial flux and shrinking-cone comparison using smooth indicator cutoffs. Separated localization supports and radius exhaustion account for every cutoff term without an assumed rough artificial-face trace.

B7 proves uniqueness for identical arbitrary natural-dual forcing by subtracting the complete functionals first. Quantitative comparison requires their difference to be an interior L2 source. The original weak solution is identified only after a candidate has actual matching energy space, functional, boundary data and past.

Three complete exercises prove the simultaneous-gauge obstruction, every term of a time-dependent noncommuting nilpotent example and exact original-variable smooth boundary liftings. The figure plots a specified energy ellipse and normal-gauge profiles, not unproved wave solutions.

Twelve local entries bind to 618 earlier entries in 32 current maps, including 92 external Lebl providers. Representation existence, sharp general Airy energy mapping, incoming regularity and strict propagation remain unfinished.
